youtube.title: Why Helium Makes Your Voice Squeaky 🎈 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Helium does not raise the pitch of your vocal cords, which keep vibrating at the same rate. Sound travels nearly three times faster in helium than in air, so the resonances of your throat and mouth shift to higher frequencies. Those boosted high tones are what make your voice sound squeaky and cartoonish.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
